name: Transfer Learning
learningObjectives: Understand how pre-trained models can be reused for new tasks
Learn the difference between feature extraction and fine-tuning
Explore how transfer learning reduces training time and data requirements
Visualize extracted features from pre-trained networks
Compare frozen vs. fine-tuned feature extractors

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose a dataset for the new classification task

controls.label: Freeze Feature Extractor
controls.tooltip: When enabled, only trains the classifier. When disabled, fine-tunes the feature extractor too.

controls.label: Feature Extractor Layers
controls.tooltip: Number of layers in the pre-trained feature extractor

controls.label: Fine-Tune Layers
controls.tooltip: Number of feature extractor layers to fine-tune (when not frozen)

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Learning rate for training. Transfer learning typically uses smaller rates.

controls.label: Epochs
controls.tooltip: Number of training iterations. Transfer learning often needs fewer epochs.

visualizations.title: Extracted Feature Space
visualizations.description: 2D projection of features extracted by the pre-trained model

visualizations.title: Confusion Matrix
visualizations.description: Classification performance on the new task
